text:
Eli P: Quick pass on the compare UI prototypes - figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/GHI. Main asks: filter chip persistence, accessible badge variants (colorblind-friendly), and clearer version lock behavior when comparing >2 models.

Nora V: My research note: users expect filters to persist per-tab not globally. If they switch to the model detail page and back, filters should be preserved for that session only. Prefer sessionStorage + URL fallback.

Diego M: Engineering note: avoid re-creating chip elements on every nav. Use a small cache keyed by filter hash to rehydrate state quickly. Also suggest a compact compare density toggle so users can choose fewer metrics inline.

Maya K: Badge accessibility: add a pattern variant (dot + label) for colorblind mode and include text label on hover/tap. Rename ambiguous "perf" badge to explicit metrics (Latency / Cost / Throughput).

Eli P: Pin UX: proposal = single-click opens a tiny confirm popover "Lock version for this comparison? [Lock] [Cancel]" with an undo snackbar afterwards. Expose an advanced toggle "Apply lock to all comparisons" for power users.

ux-bot: Added experiment flag catalog_compare_colorblind_mode to staging. Use `/ff catalog_compare_colorblind_mode on` to test.

Diego M: I'll implement cache + URL encoding: `?compare=ids:123,456&filters=family:gpt&density=compact`. Will also wire undo telemetry `catalog.pin_undo`.

Maya K: Great. We'll test with keyboard + screenreader flows in the next usability round. Sync Friday 9am to lock copy and ship behind flag.
